problems.explain: The two small triangles, △ACD and △CBD, are similar, so AD/CD = CD/DB: CD² = AD × DB. 4² = 16, so AD = 16 ÷ 8 = 2. So AD = 2.

problems.explain: 1 : 24 means every length on the real car is 24 times the model’s, in the same unit. 12 × 24 = 288 cm. There are 100 cm in a meter: 288 ÷ 100 = 2.88. (The scale has no units of its own, so the answer comes out in centimeters first.) So 2.88 m.

prompt.v: In △ABC, D is on AB and E is on AC, with DE parallel to BC. AD = 10, DB = 10 and AE = 10. What is EC?

problems.text: side splitter: AD 10, DB 10, AE 10; find EC
problems.explain: A line parallel to one side splits the other two in the same ratio: AD/DB = AE/EC. So 10/10 = 10/EC, and EC = 10 × 10 ÷ 10 = 10. Check: AE is 1 times AD, and EC is 1 times DB. So EC = 10.

problems.explain: A volume has three lengths multiplied in it, so it grows by the factor cubed: 4³ = 64. 3 × 64 = 192. (3 × 4 scales it like a length.) So 192 cm³.
